# Dicer component license

The MIT license in [LICENSE](./LICENSE) applies **only** to the dicer multipart parser in this directory. It does **not** apply to `@radicalimaging/static-wado-webserver`, the static-dicomweb monorepo, or any other bundled software.

Maintained fork of [dicer](https://github.com/mscdex/dicer) by Brian White. TypeScript sources live in this directory; `bun run build` (`tsc` on `lib/`) emits compiled dicer to `dist/vendor/dicer/`. Standalone package: `z:\src\dicer` (releases TBD).
